text_elements.text: ShopEase Customer Support Knowledge Base
FAQ, refund policy, shipping policy, product catalogue, warranty policy and support solutions Document version 1.1
Business Profile

ShopEase is an online electronics and accessories store. Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM India Standard Time (IST), excluding public holidays. The support email address is support@shopease.example. A support phone number is not provided.

Customers should never share passwords, OTPs, full card numbers, CVV values or banking PINs with ShopEase support. For account-specific help, only the minimum information needed is requested through the official support channel.
1. Frequently Asked Questions
How can I place an order?

Browse the ShopEase catalogue, add the product to your cart, enter your delivery address, choose an available payment method and confirm the order. An order confirmation is displayed after the order is placed successfully.
Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
The delivery address can be changed only before the order is packed for dispatch. Contact support as soon as possible after placing the order.
How can I cancel an order?

An order can be cancelled before it is marked as shipped. Once an order has shipped, cancellation is not available through the standard process. The customer may request a return after delivery if the item is eligible.
How do I track my order?
Use the tracking link in the order-shipped notification, or open the Orders section of your ShopEase account.
What should I do if I receive the wrong item?
Keep the item and its packaging, take clear photos of the received product and the package label, and contact support within 48 hours of delivery.
What payment methods are supported?
ShopEase supports UPI, debit cards, credit cards and cash on delivery where that option is shown at checkout. Availability may vary by delivery location.
Can I return an opened product?

Eligibility depends on the product category and condition. Most products must be unused and returned with original packaging. Hygiene-related items and certain consumables are not returnable unless they are damaged, defective or incorrectly supplied.

When will I receive my refund?

After the returned item passes inspection and the refund is approved, the refund is initiated within 2 business days. The time for the amount to appear in the account depends on the payment provider and is usually about 5 to 7 business days.
How do I contact customer support?
Email support@shopease.example during support hours, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.
Does ShopEase offer a warranty?
Selected products include a manufacturer or seller warranty. The warranty period is listed in the product catalogue entry and in the warranty information supplied with the product.
Is cash on delivery available?
Cash on delivery is available where the option is shown at checkout. Some products and delivery locations do not support cash on delivery.
Are shipping charges applied?
Shipping charges, if any, are displayed at checkout before the customer confirms the order.
Can I get express delivery?
Express delivery is available only for eligible products and PIN codes. It is guaranteed only when the checkout page explicitly confirms the express service for that order.
How long does it take to process an order?
Orders are normally prepared for dispatch within 1 to 2 business days after payment confirmation.
What happens if my parcel arrives damaged?
Photograph the package before opening it where practical, then photograph the item and report the issue to support within 48 hours of delivery.

2. Refund Policy
Refund eligibility
A customer may request a refund for an eligible item within 7 calendar days of delivery.
The item must meet the return conditions: it must be unused, undamaged (unless damage or a defect is being reported) and returned with its original packaging, accessories and included items.
Damaged, defective or incorrect items must be reported within 48 hours of delivery, with clear photographs where possible.
Products marked Final Sale are not eligible for change-of-mind returns. This does not remove the ability to report an item that arrived damaged, defective or incorrect.
Hygiene-related products, personalised items and opened consumables are not eligible for change-of-mind returns.
Refund process

Step 1: The customer submits a return or refund request through the ShopEase account or by emailing support. Step 2: Support checks the order and eligibility. Step 3: If the request is approved, the customer receives return instructions. Step 4: The returned item is inspected after it reaches the return facility. Step 5: If the inspection is successful, the refund is initiated within 2 business days.
Refund timing

The refund is initiated within 2 business days after the returned item passes inspection and the refund is approved. After initiation, the payment provider may take approximately 5 to 7 business days to show the amount in the customer's account. The actual timing depends on the bank or payment provider.

For cash-on-delivery orders, an approved refund is paid by bank transfer to the account details collected through the official, secure support process. Banking passwords, PINs and OTPs are never requested.
Non-refundable situations
Change-of-mind return requests received after the 7-calendar-day return window are not refundable.
Items with customer-caused damage, misuse or missing components are not refundable, unless the issue was reported as an original delivery defect and verified.
Final Sale items are not refundable for change-of-mind reasons.
Who handles refunds
Refund approval, product inspection, payment verification and refund status checks are carried out by authorised support agents with access to the order system.

3. Shipping Policy
Delivery estimates
Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days and is available for most serviceable locations.
Express delivery takes 1 to 3 business days and is available only for eligible products and PIN codes.
Delivery to remote locations takes 5 to 10 business days and may require additional transit time.
Shipping rules
Business days are Monday through Saturday, excluding public holidays. Sundays and public holidays are not counted in delivery estimates.
Orders are normally prepared for dispatch within 1 to 2 business days after payment confirmation.
Delivery estimates begin after dispatch, not at the time the cart is created.
Shipping charges, if any, are displayed at checkout before the customer confirms the order.
Express delivery is not guaranteed unless the checkout page explicitly confirms the service for that order.
Delayed, failed or damaged delivery
If tracking has not updated for more than 48 hours, the customer should contact support with the order reference.

If delivery is marked complete but the customer has not received the parcel, the customer should first check with household members, reception or the building's parcel collection point, and then contact support within 48 hours of the delivery notification.
If the parcel arrives visibly damaged, photograph the package before opening it where practical, then photograph the item and report the issue within 48 hours.
A shipment investigation may be required for missing or damaged parcels. Compensation is provided only when confirmed by support.
Address and delivery restrictions
Customers should verify their PIN code and full address before confirming an order.
Address changes are possible only before the order is packed for dispatch, and the customer must contact support promptly.
Some products or delivery locations may not support cash on delivery or express shipping.
